name: Texarkana Winter 2022
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexarkanaWinter2022#20337-competitor-responsibilities) tab. For more information on cubing in Texas, check out the [Texas Speedcubing Facebook Group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1433959593548054)!
